repository.description: Smart Factory edge: Raspberry Pi gateway, ESP32 WROVER sensors, and Arduino robotic-arm firmware with MQTT telemetry, OPC UA, Modbus, and serial adapters.

pulls.title: Reduce telemetry uplink traffic and preserve MQTT retries
pulls.body:
The Pi previously forwarded identical sensor readings and redundant heartbeats every five seconds. It now coalesces identical live readings, sends a full snapshot roughly every 60 seconds, and forwards every measurement, sensor-status and button-signal change. Pi heartbeats also use a 60-second interval. TLS and QoS 1 remain enabled.

Local MQTT messages are manually acknowledged after durable acceptance or intentional coalescing. Queue failures leave messages unacknowledged and trigger service restart for persistent-session redelivery. Historical samples preserve their timestamps and bypass coalescing. The release includes payload counters, a reversible Pi installer, dependency pins and current Oracle deployment documentation.

Validation: 55 gateway tests passed; dependency audit found no known vulnerabilities; isolated real-broker outage, queue-full, reconnect and durable-reopen probes passed on both Mac and Pi. Live production checks observed both devices online, an empty delivery queue and no automatic gateway restarts. Four minutes of counters measured 75.3% fewer forwarded sensor payload bytes and 81.82% fewer sensor messages; transport overhead is excluded.

The runtime source is already deployed on the Pi in `telemetry-20261016T131325Z` and was verified by source hashes. This PR records that deployment; CI never flashes hardware.

pulls.title: Validate and preserve provenance across durable MQTT and serial ingestion
pulls.body:
Smart Factory's existing edge relay preserves mode/run identities, source quality, connection, retained status and distinct measurement/receipt time through its durable publisher. MQTT and serial ingestion independently enforce the same documented bounded provenance policy as the app server and backend; malformed receipt times are rejected rather than replaced with current time. Absent provenance remains legacy unknown data.

Revalidated on 2026-10-26 at 700c9a55a211105171a1d58a8a3b3c3ce5832125: 61 tests passed, exercising 99 locally copied acceptance/normalization cases through both MQTT and serial paths, plus extreme numeric input. [Gateway and firmware CI passed](https://github.com/DruHustle/smart-factory-iot-edge/actions/runs/40246096767). Real durable MQTT publication delivered 10 simulated and 10 replay samples through Smart Factory's .NET 8 and authenticated Node services, including receiver outage and recovery, without promoting generated data to live equipment.

[Policy and recovery](https://github.com/DruHustle/smart-factory-iot-edge/blob/feat/equipment-telemetry-provenance/docs/telemetry-provenance-policy.md). No peer application package, new subscription or required Onesa configuration is introduced. Physical gateways, PLC operation, phones and actual external-consumer acceptance remain unqualified. Keep draft; no merge or manual production deployment.

[Final independent workspace qualification and repeated ingestion evidence](https://github.com/DruHustle/smart-factory-iot-frontend/blob/feat/native-equipment-monitoring/docs/equipment-evidence.md) records the exact tested sources, receiver outage/recovery and remaining physical/external qualification gates.

pulls.title: Add industrial device connectivity with OPC UA FX and TSN diagnostics
pulls.body:
## Why this change is needed

The gateway's existing asset profile maps equipment into six scalar metrics. Industrial devices also need independent typed tags, protocol-specific addressing, source quality and timestamps, and connection diagnostics. This adds those capabilities alongside the existing asset profile and delivery path.

## Changes

- Add independently scheduled, read-only drivers for OPC UA monitored subscriptions, Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT JSON, and commissioned OPC UA UADP reception.
- Add OPC UA FX namespace/type discovery and local TSN evidence collection through fixed read-only LinuxPTP, ethtool, tc and sysfs operations.
- Introduce revisioned `industrial-connectivity/v1` desired state and `industrial-observation/v1` typed telemetry. Configurations use a separate retained `/commands/connectivity` route; existing asset configuration remains on `/commands`.
- Preserve gateway identity, strict provenance, durable SQLite spooling and event IDs. Add configuration receipts, correlated read-only probes, exclusive serial ownership, reconnect isolation and bounded report cadence.
- Enforce local destination/interface/serial allowlists and local credential references. Support exact Int64/UInt64 decimal strings, source type checks, engineering scaling and UTF-8 message budgets.
- Add a reusable loopback protocol bench, shared contract fixture, commissioning documentation, exact-topic ACL example, and a required real-protocol CI gate using the existing pinned Mosquitto container.

## Validation

- 111 unit/regression tests passed. The default suite discovers 120 tests and skips the nine separately enabled protocol tests.
- All nine real-protocol tests passed: OPC UA monitored changes and native status, positive FX discovery and ordinary-UA negative case, Modbus TCP typed values/coils/errors, actual RTU bytes and CRC through a commissioned pseudo-terminal, MQTT retained/malformed/stale handling, UADP keyframe forms and sequence behavior, and legacy v1 OPC UA/Modbus compatibility.
- Coordinated Python gateway → MQTT → .NET outbox → Node/PostgreSQL qualification passed. A measured 3.229-second broker outage durably buffered three observations; each event persisted once with unchanged acquisition timestamps, the queue drained, and all five test connections recovered.
- Unicode boundary, atomic save/reload, cached probe timestamp, spool restart and malformed UADP regressions passed.
- Published tree `5915f04d4a1d7c248f7e971421984efc98b20d4d` matches the locally qualified tree exactly. Existing dependency pins are unchanged.

## FX and TSN scope

FX support here is information-model diagnostics and a commissioned scalar UADP observer. It does not establish FX logical connections, publish control traffic, implement PubSub key exchange, or accept every FX transport/profile. The bounded UDP profile requires explicit publisher/group/writer identity and metadata; unsupported signed/encrypted, delta/chunk, array/structured and omitted-header profiles are rejected.

Unsigned UDP remains `unauthenticated_udp` evidence and does not become a trusted good/current measurement. TSN collection reports observed capabilities and clock/qdisc evidence with `determinism: "unverified"`; it does not reconfigure clocks, schedules, interfaces or switches. Software tests and pseudo-terminal RTU tests do not claim physical device or deterministic-network qualification.

See [the industrial connectivity guide](docs/industrial-connectivity.md) for exact supported layouts, limits and commissioning settings.

pulls.title: Repair staged gateway release qualification and rollback
pulls.body:
## Problem

The staged gateway installer cannot qualify the current multiline, hash-pinned requirements file. Its flattened source layout also omits the shared connectivity and provenance fixtures, so staged unit tests fail. A base-directory upload can leave an older release active when systemd already has a release override.

## Changes

- Retain `raspberry-pi/` beside `fixtures/` in checksummed release bundles; require coverage for every copied input and record the reviewed full source revision.
- Parse exact dependency pins with SHA-256 continuations, install from the offline wheelhouse with `--require-hashes`, and verify installed metadata before qualification.
- Discover the effective service's explicit Python/script paths, including legacy installation paths, and stage an independent copy of its virtual environment.
- Run staged unit tests as `smartfactory` before switching only the managed `60-gateway-release.conf` ExecStart. Recheck concurrent service changes and abort before restarting if another override wins.
- Preserve existing environment files, credentials, broker configuration and queued state. Restore the previous managed override's bytes, owner, group and mode on rollback; refuse stale rollback after a subsequent change.
- Document complete bundle creation, actual ExecStart inspection, service-readable 0600 connectivity credentials, separate Pi deployment, and the compatible-service drain barrier required before an old cloud consumer rollback.

## Validation

- Local full unit discovery: **124 passed**, with the **9 existing opt-in protocol cases skipped** in that unit invocation.
- **13 new installer tests**, including a real offline hashed-wheel install into a temporary virtual environment, exact installed-version checks, staged shared-fixture loading, legacy paths, failed qualification/health, concurrent changes, conflicting overrides and rollback metadata.
- All systemd and runuser boundaries are mocked in the isolated installer tests. The real target account's access is checked by the installer's pre-cutover runuser gate.
- Independent installer review completed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Published tree `f5a772205efb2ea8268d2ec48ed5012ad87dd313` exactly matches the locally tested tree. The existing edge CI will separately require all nine real protocol tests, MQTT recovery and firmware compilation.

This is a gateway deployment repair. Applying the Oracle image's edge source label does not install gateway software or commission factory equipment.
